title: Good albums provided, Needs to provide better value or  choice
text:
I went two months with the subscription. I like the choices I received alright, two Barry Grundman remastered rock classics (Dark Side of The Moon, Van Halen s/t) but I'm quitting because I just don't see the value or choice that makes this a truly worthy "record club."

If it were a better value, I could take the unknown random choice, but these are basically albums that regularly sell at a standard discount at around $25 being sold at $25. I'm assuming they are trying to move overstock, so why not give the subscriber a deal we can truly appreciate as an incentive? $15 iseems like a decent price for getting quality overstock records.

Alternately, give us a limited choice. It should still be a better value though. If it were down to $20 or so but you got to choose from a limited amount of choices of the month, I might come back.

Charging us $25 for a $25 record... when you could instead buy a different one of your specific choice at the same price... doesn't make sense.

...and actually, the VH is currently selling for a bit less than $25... but I had the privilege of paying a little more.
label: neutral
